io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.installer

Class AddonReleaseService

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.installer.AddonReleaseService

  • public final class AddonReleaseService
extends java.lang.Object
    Talks to the GitHub Releases API for a single entry: finds the latest release's version tag and downloadable jar asset, and downloads jars. All methods are blocking - call them off the main thread.

    • Method Detail

      • fetchLatest

        @Nullable
public AddonReleaseService.ReleaseInfo fetchLatest(@Nonnull
                                                             AddonCatalog.Entry entry)
        Fetches the latest release for an entry. For core we use /releases/latest, which excludes prereleases (the gh-v* GitHub-only builds), so it returns the latest stable v* release. Addons use the same endpoint.
        Returns:
        the resolved release, or null if there is no release, no jar asset, or the request failed.

      • fetchReleases

        @Nonnull
public java.util.List<AddonReleaseService.ReleaseInfo> fetchReleases(@Nonnull
                                                                              AddonCatalog.Entry entry)
        Fetches all published releases for an entry (newest first, as GitHub returns them), each that has a downloadable jar asset. Used by the version picker so a player can install (or downgrade to) any past release, not just the latest.
        Returns:
        the releases with a jar asset; empty if none or the request failed.

      • fetchBranchHead

        @Nullable
public java.lang.String fetchBranchHead(@Nonnull
                                                  AddonCatalog.Entry entry,
                                                  @Nonnull
                                                  java.lang.String branch)
        Fetches the short commit SHA at the head of a branch (for update-checking branch installs). Blocking - call off the main thread.
        Returns:
        the 7-char short SHA, or null if the branch/repo is unreachable.

      • downloadJar

        public boolean downloadJar(@Nonnull
                           java.lang.String jarUrl,
                           @Nonnull
                           java.io.File targetDir,
                           @Nonnull
                           java.lang.String fileName)
        Downloads a jar to the target directory under the given file name. Writes to a .tmp file then atomically renames into place, so a failed download never leaves a half-written jar.
        Returns:
        true on success.

      • downloadJar

        public boolean downloadJar(@Nonnull
                           java.lang.String jarUrl,
                           @Nonnull
                           java.io.File targetDir,
                           @Nonnull
                           java.lang.String fileName,
                           @Nullable
                           java.util.function.DoubleConsumer onProgress)
        As downloadJar(String, File, String), but reports download progress as a fraction in [0,1] to onProgress. When the server doesn't send a content length, progress can't be computed and the callback is not invoked (callers should show an indeterminate state).
        Returns:
        true on success.
